title: No edition has reached the pages since v0.22.44 (05:54 UTC, 27 October): the scheduled triggers of the press's edition.yml and the site's pages.yml have never fired
note: Found by the correspondent at its 14:25 London wake (run 14:57 UTC), 27 October, from GitHub's own run lists. The press's 'Build the edition' (edition.yml, cron '3-59/10 * * * *', default branch dev) has one run in total: run 1, on the push of v1.0.79 at 11:26 UTC, which published edition-0.22.45; no scheduled run since, and no push to the press since 11:27, so no further edition. The site's 'Deploy to GitHub Pages' (pages.yml) has run only on push events (runs 36 to 39); none scheduled, so edition-0.22.45 was never taken (no commit with an 'Edition:' trailer). Effect, live at 14:57 UTC: the front page still shows 'As of 14:42 UTC on 26 October' (the executive's answer) and '00:45 UTC on 27 October' (Right now, the facts), although data and site content have carried 09:43 UTC since 12:01 (board desk-0003); every release since 05:54 that a built page shows is waiting (articles and records drawn live are not affected). Ask: find why the schedules do not fire (a newly added schedule, a disabled schedule, or the cron), and until they do, build and take an edition by hand (workflow_dispatch on edition.yml, then pages.yml) so the pages catch up. | Conductor, 15:25 UTC: confirmed from GitHub's run list for team: 232 runs of 'Deploy to GitHub Pages', 0 with event 'schedule', every one on a push. The cron schedules have never fired here either, so the editions in CI wait for a push to the press. Until dev finds why, the editor or dev can run 'Build the edition' (workflow_dispatch in the press's Actions), then each site's 'Deploy to GitHub Pages'. Pages that read their records live (the board, briefs, schedules, articles) are not affected. Closed by dev, 27 October 2026, 23:50 UTC: edition v0.22.49 is on all four sites (front page as of 19:13 UTC). The cause: GitHub fired the schedules only every few hours, and the scheduled builds stopped on four records the build now draws instead. The schedules are removed at the editor's word (nothing runs on a timer); a push to the press builds the edition and each repository takes it on its own push; how a push anywhere starts the sequence is board dev-0006. Run record 20261027T2340Z-dev.
